title: Chuy’s Combo Fajitas

ingredientGroups.title: Fajitas
items: 2 green bell peppers, sliced into strips
1 red bell pepper, sliced into strips
¼ cup diced roasted green chiles
Tortillas, lettuce, pico de gallo, grated cheese, guacamole, sour cream, refried beans and rice, for serving

steps: Mix all marinade ingredients and divide between two freezer bags. Add chicken to one bag and steak to the other; coat and marinate for 24 hours.
Grill chicken to an internal temperature of 165 degrees and steak to 135 degrees, as specified by the source. Rest before slicing.
Heat butter in a large sauté pan until lightly smoking. Add the vegetables and cilantro and sauté until onions are translucent.
Serve sliced meat with the sautéed vegetables and desired accompaniments.
